body:
domain:devx#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbX9avDwM2goWd7zimE
Part of #27377 (wave 4, W4-C3b1)

QA run record for the 18.3.0 release-candidate sweep, card W4-C3b1: the unpinned `browser` and `mixed` items of studio-authoring, records-forms, approvals, automation and dashboards, 36 items. Every clause was driven live in a real browser (Playwright chromium) plus its API half, against the Console built in-repo from the subject. Item verdicts are derived from the clause verdicts, never hand-assigned. Run under `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` and `docs/qa/platform-checklist/RUNNER.md`. Compared against wave 3 record #27441.

The per-clause verdict table is too long for one issue body (about 130 KB of one-line evidence), so it is posted as the three comments that follow this record, in item order. Everything else is here.

## Environment fingerprint

- Framework: `7fa9873f38f7a0158e3ce17338dcc0f446b113e3` (main, 2026-11-02T02:44:25Z), detached and pinned; it never followed main. `ui/` is the same commit. `npm_config_nodedir=/opt/node22 pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` (34 s), `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter=!@objectstack/docs` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (15m57s, exit 0), `pnpm console:build --concurrency=2` (cache hit + copy, 3 s), `node scripts/check-dev-prereqs.mjs` green (106 artifacts). Chromium build 1243 matches playwright-core.
- Boot (per runner): a tar copy of `examples/app-showcase` under the runner's own scratch dir, `node_modules` symlinked to the tree. Command: `OS_PORT=PORT OS_STORAGE_LOCAL_ROOT=RUN/uploads OS_HOME=RUN/home setsid node packages/cli/bin/run.js dev --ui --seed-admin --no-watch -p PORT -d file:RUN/data.db`. A canary on 41300 measured health 200 in about 12 s, `/_console/` 200, and `GET /api/v1/meta/app` naming `showcase_app, setup, account`.
- Ports 41310–41414: one block of five per runner (41310 R1a, 41320 R1b, 41330 R2a, 41340 R2b, 41350 R3, 41360 R4a, 41370 R4b, 41380 R5, 41390 R6, 41400 R7, 41410 R8). Every runner had its own file DB and browser context.
- Extra boots, each on the runner's own port and DB: walled `group` boots (`OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=group OS_PLATFORM_OWNER_EMAIL=admin@objectos.ai OS_AUTH_MEMBERSHIP_POLICY=invite-only`) for approvals.decision-action-matrix A9 (41322) and for an approvals probe (41311); a fresh stock DB for the decision matrix (41321); a fresh DB for an automation clone probe (41341).
- Seed: `--seed-admin` (admin@objectos.ai), the stock showcase seed and its demo personas. Members were minted per RUNNER, by invite then sign-up or by admin create-user. Each persona's identity was proved with `GET /api/v1/auth/get-session` before its cells. Writable scratch packages (`POST /api/v1/packages`) carried the authoring fixtures; the `qaact-placement-specimen` and `qagroup` recipes were installed into the scratch app copies only.
- Execution: 11 runner subagents, at most 3 browser runners at a time, staggered. The orchestrator read every runner's result, checked every FAIL disposition against source and the ledger, and checked each extracted defect against the board before filing.
- Hygiene: after the run, `git status` is clean, `examples/app-showcase/.objectstack` does not exist, and no listener remains on 41300–41415. Scratch packages, install-local recipes and drafts were deleted or discarded by each runner, or live only in its scratch DB.
- Time: environment prep about 74 min (22 min orchestrator: install, build, console, canary; 52 min summed across runners: copies, boots and fixtures) against about 256 min of testing plus 67 min of off-clause probes, summed across runners. Prep to testing is about 1 : 3.5 (1 : 4.4 with probes). Wall clock: 03:33Z to 05:54Z for the runs.

## Scope

Selector `release-18.3.0-w4-c3b1`: the unpinned browser/mixed list of anchor #27377 wave 4, card W4-C3b1, as computed at the subject (`/mnt/project-files/release-18.3.0/W4-C3b1-items.txt`). No planned items in the set. Revisions, read from the ledger at the subject (`node scripts/checklist-select.mjs ID --json`):

approvals.per-group-signoff r11 · approvals.quorum-m-of-n r9 · approvals.inbox-metadata-actions r8 · approvals.viewer-gating-submitter-side r7 · approvals.decision-action-matrix r10 · automation.flow-run-step-nesting r8 · automation.rollup-summary-filter r7 · automation.flow-node-type-matrix r12 · automation.flow-error-handling r6 · automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract r10 · dashboards.strict-widget-rejects-stray-keys r3 · dashboards.chart-type-matrix r7 · dashboards.global-filters-rescope r5 · records-forms.form-view-gallery r6 · records-forms.action-location-matrix r18 · records-forms.calendar-interactions r4 · records-forms.field-group-visible-when r11 · studio-authoring.view-authoring-live r5 · studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle r10 · studio-authoring.authoring-validation-not-persisted r5 · studio-authoring.packaged-automation-studio-lock r6 · studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu r9 · studio-authoring.held-edit-leave-guard r5 · studio-authoring.flow-edge-type-authoring r4 · studio-authoring.summary-field-authoring r5 · studio-authoring.api-written-keys-survive-studio-save r3 · studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types r5 · studio-authoring.report-authoring-options r3 · studio-authoring.app-and-nav-properties r5 · studio-authoring.authored-page-slots-and-variables r3 · studio-authoring.access-permission-set-lifecycle r4 · studio-authoring.access-facets-runtime r4 · studio-authoring.access-owd-and-suggestions r5 · studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix r4 · studio-authoring.uninstalled-package-refused r3 · studio-authoring.expression-editors r8

Clause ids: `A#` is `acceptance[#]` and `N#` is `negative[#]`, both zero-based.

`studio-authoring.expression-editors` was run here as the live retest of the #27482 residual: its browser autosave clauses are judged live; its A7 is a pin-only clause, recorded `skipped` here because the pin belongs to card W4-C2b.

## Derived item verdicts

29 PASS / 0 PARTIAL / 7 FAIL / 0 BLOCKED / 0 NOT-RUN (36 of 36 judged).

- FAIL (7), with disposition:
  - automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract (A1, A2, A6): stale spec, ADR-0146 D4 / #28149.
  - studio-authoring.packaged-automation-studio-lock (A0 New half, A2): stale spec, ADR-0146 D3 / #28572 and D4 / #28148.
  - studio-authoring.access-permission-set-lifecycle (A3): stale spec, ADR-0146 D3 / #28572.
  - studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle (A10): stale spec, #28355 (refused saves now write a denied audit row).
  - studio-authoring.expression-editors (A2, A4, A6, N0): stale spec against the #26858 ruling and #27612's shipped design; the re-point waits on the open #27482.
  - studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types (A4): product defect (a partly filled nested list input autosaves and is refused).
  - studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix (A1, A2, N0): product defect, four inert keys and one unrendered key (titleFormat, field.searchable, list-view sharing.lockedBy without a type, view.form drawerSide/drawerWidth, the report null bucket label).
- PASS (29): every other item.

Wave-3 off-clause cards re-checked here: #27451 holds (`GET /api/v1/approvals/requests/UNKNOWN/actions` → 404 REQUEST_NOT_FOUND), #27460 holds (a two-dimension sankey draws 8 links for 8 cells), #27445 holds (an undeclared filterBindings key → 422 at save and at publish), #27452 holds (no stale server error under newly edited RLS text). No PASS turned into a product-defect FAIL.

## Reproduction rule for every `fail`

R-1 · automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract · A1 / A2 / A6 · stale spec (ADR-0146 D4, amended 2026-10-31; #28149; notice reworded by #27886)
1. Boot the showcase on its own port and DB; sign in admin@objectos.ai.
2. `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_urgent_task_alert/clone {"name":"qa_urgent_alert_clone","label":"QA urgent alert clone"}` → 200 `data:{flow:{… status:"obsolete"}, packageId:"com.example.showcase.custom", notice:"The copy is switched off and does not run until you switch it on, and it still uses the same subflows, actions and objects as the original."}`.
3. `GET /api/v1/automation/qa_urgent_alert_clone` → `_packageId:"com.example.showcase.custom"`, status obsolete.
4. `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task {title, project, priority:"urgent"}` three times; read both flows' runs → base +1 per create, clone 0.
5. Cold restart on the same DB; `/_console/studio/~org/automations` → "No flows outside a package…"; `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/automations` lists the clone, "In com.example.showcase.custom".
Expected (clause r10): a package-less clone, status draft, armed (double-fire), listed on `~org`. Actual: as above, matching `packages/runtime/src/flow-clone.ts` (`FLOW_CLONE_STATUS`, `FLOW_CLONE_NOTICE`) and `resolveCloneTarget`. Reproduced with two clones over two processes.

R-2 · studio-authoring.packaged-automation-studio-lock · A0 (New half) / A2 · stale spec (ADR-0146 D3 #28572 "New lands in the pair"; D4 #28148 "the ledger switch, on the item")
1. Form sign-in as admin; `GET /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase` → `writable:false`.
2. `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/automations?surface=flow%3Ashowcase_urgent_task_alert` (rail, "Read-only" badge, header switch "On for this deployment").
3. `[data-testid=studio-rail-add]` ("New automation") is present and opens the New dialog, which targets the `.custom` pair.
4. `[role=switch][data-testid=auto-ledger-switch]` is enabled; clicking it posts `POST /api/v1/automation/showcase_urgent_task_alert/toggle {"enabled":false}` → 200, then `{"enabled":true}` → 200. The flow definition stays byte-identical (`GET /api/v1/meta/flow` md5 unchanged).
Expected (clause r6): no New; the switch disabled with no request. Actual: as above, matching `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` (`newInPair`, `ledgerRow` → FlowLedgerSwitch). Reproduced on 2 fresh loads each. The lock itself holds (A1, A3, N0, N1 pass: forged writes 403 ITEM_LOCKED / NOT_OVERRIDABLE, inspector inputs disabled).

R-3 · studio-authoring.access-permission-set-lifecycle · A3 · stale spec (ADR-0146 D3, #28572)
1. Form sign-in → `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/access?surface=permission:showcase_contributor`.
2. `getByTestId('studio-rail-add')` ("New permission set") is present and enabled beside the "Read-only" chip.
3. Click → "New permission set" → "QR7 Pair Set" → Save as draft → `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.showcase/ensure-customization` 201 `{"packageId":"com.example.showcase.custom","created":true}`, then `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/qr7_pair_set?mode=draft&package=com.example.showcase.custom&surface=studio` 200.
Expected (clause): a read-only package offers no New set. Actual: New lands in the pair, never in the base; the packaged set's own controls are all disabled (192 matrix checkboxes) and forged writes are refused (A4 passes). Reproduced on 2 fresh loads.

R-4 · studio-authoring.draft-publish-lifecycle · A10 · stale spec (#28355)
1. As admin: `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/qa_lifecycle_probe?mode=draft&package=PKG` with a widget carrying a stray key (`"object":"showcase_task"`) → 422 INVALID_METADATA `widgets.0 [unrecognized_keys]`.
2. `GET /api/v1/meta/dashboard/qa_lifecycle_probe/audit`.
Expected (clause r10): a 422 spec refusal writes no row. Actual: one row per refusal, `{"source":"protocol.saveMetaItem","operation":"save","outcome":"denied","code":"invalid_metadata","actor":"ADMIN_ID",…}`, by design of `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-refusal-audit.ts` (`REFUSAL_AUDIT_CODES` = NOT_OVERRIDABLE, NOT_CREATABLE, INVALID_METADATA, DESTRUCTIVE_CHANGE). A NO_DRAFT 404 still writes none, and every row carries the authenticated actor. Reproduced 2 of 2 with two different bodies.

R-5 · studio-authoring.expression-editors · A2 / A4 / A6 / N0 · stale spec (#26858 ruling "no client copy of any publish rule"; #27612's shipped design; re-point waits on #27482)
1. `POST /api/v1/packages {"manifest":{"id":"com.qa.rsx","name":"QA R7 Expr","version":"0.1.0","type":"app","namespace":"qrx"}}`.
2. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qrx_job?mode=draft&package=com.qa.rsx` (sharingModel public_read_write; number `est_hours`; select `status`; formula `f_formula` = `record.est_hours * 1.1`); publish-drafts.
3. `PUT /api/v1/meta/permission/qrx_job_editor?mode=draft&package=com.qa.rsx` with objects.qrx_job read/edit and one select RLS policy `using: "record.status == 'open'"`; publish.
4. Form sign-in → `/_console/studio/com.qa.rsx/access?surface=permission:qrx_job_editor` → Row-level security → USING (read filter) = `record.f_formula > 5`.
Expected (clause as written): an error-tier lint and the save held, no PUT. Actual: "Valid CEL" for about 1.7 s, then `PUT …/qrx_job_editor?mode=draft&package=com.qa.rsx&surface=studio` 200, then the server's INVALID_FIELD verdict at the field; publish → 422 `rls-predicate-unenforceable`. Each newly refused text autosaves once more; an edit to another clause is held. Non-pushdownable and parse-fault predicates are held with 0 PUTs. Reproduced on 3 fresh loads. This is the residual #27482 describes; the item's own knownGaps[3] says to score these fail until #27482 is ruled.

R-6 · studio-authoring.dashboard-widget-and-filter-types · A4 · product defect (extracted)
1. A writable package with an app whose navigation names a dashboard with one metric widget (here `com.qa.r3`, dashboard `r3_hold` on dataset `r3_ticket_metrics`).
2. `/_console/studio/PKG/interfaces` → the dashboard → Properties → Filters → Global Filters → "Add item" (0 PUTs, held as designed).
3. Fill Field (`region`), set Input Type = select (each `PUT /api/v1/meta/dashboard/r3_hold?mode=draft&package=PKG&surface=studio` 200).
4. Type `r3_ticket` into Options From → Object (`#mdf-globalFilters.N.optionsFrom.object`) and Tab → the PUT carries `"optionsFrom":{"object":"r3_ticket"}` → 422 INVALID_METADATA, `globalFilters.N.optionsFrom.valueField [invalid_type]; …labelField [invalid_type]`.
5. Edit the dashboard Description, then its Label → each PUT carries the same incomplete item and is refused 422; the banner reads "Changes not saved: the server refused this draft…".
6. Reload → no leave prompt (`new Event('beforeunload',{cancelable:true})` → defaultPrevented false); the Description and Label edits are gone.
Expected (clause): the editor never autosaves an incomplete filter and no other edit is lost. Actual: as above. Reproduced 3 times on fresh loads. The #27459 shape (an empty Add item) holds. Suspected source: `listItemHeldInput()` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/metadataError.ts` holds an item only when the unset input sits directly below the item.

R-7 · studio-authoring.no-entry-property-matrix · A1 / A2 / N0 · product defect (extracted, one card per key)
Each row: author the key on a writable package (`PUT /api/v1/meta/TYPE/NAME?mode=draft&package=app.qar8` → `POST /api/v1/packages/app.qar8/publish-drafts` → published; the live read carries the key verbatim), then read its runtime effect.
- object.titleFormat `'{code} @ {city}'` on `qar8_tf2` with no authored nameField: the served object carries a stamped `nameField:"code"`; record `{code:'ZX-42', city:'Lyon'}` → detail H1 and list primary read "ZX-42", not "ZX-42 @ Lyon". 3 repros.
- field.searchable `true` on a `code` field and an `html` field of `qar8_fsrch2`: `GET /api/v1/data/qar8_fsrch2?$search=QQCODE` and `?$search=QQHTML` → `[]`; `?$search=QQCODE&$searchFields=snippet` → 400 INVALID_FIELD "Field 'snippet' on object 'qar8_fsrch2' is not searchable…". A field with searchable absent is scanned exactly like one with true. 3 repros.
- view.list `sharing: {lockedBy: 'admin@objectos.ai'}` (no `type`) on `qar8_vl.v_sharing`: the view opened from the switcher shows no lock indicator and no "Locked by". 3 repros. Mechanism (orchestrator, from source): `ui/packages/plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx` renders the indicator only when `schema.sharing.type` is set, while `ViewSharingSchema.type` defaults to `collaborative` in the spec.
- view.form `drawerSide:'left', drawerWidth:'480px'` on `qar8_fdr.form`: New and `/_console/forms/qar8_fdr.form` render exactly as the control (no drawer); a bad enum is refused 422, so the key is validated and never read. 2 repros. The spec describe says the drawer half "stays open on #27153", which is closed.
- dataset dimension `nullLabel:'No region (R8)'` with report `qar8_report` (summary, rows region): `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/report/qar8_report` shows the null row as "—"; the page's own `POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query` answer carries `fields.region.nullLabel` "No region (R8)". 3 repros.
Expected (clause): every key has its declared runtime effect, or is refused. Actual: as above. The four `knownGaps[1]` keys (mailAssociation, ackPlaintextMasking, lifecycle.ttl, dimensions) were left unjudged as the item says. Every other row of the matrix passed; see the clause comments.

## Fixture gaps, partial coverage and handover

- No item is partial, blocked or not-run. `studio-authoring.app-and-nav-properties` A5 leaves its requiresObject cell unjudged as its knownGaps[0] says; the clause's other keys passed. `studio-authoring.expression-editors` A7 is `skipped` (pin-only, run by W4-C2b).
- `studio-authoring.view-authoring-live`: end-user surfaces were scored as the admin, which the item allows (no non-admin grant on a runtime-authored object).
- `records-forms.field-group-visible-when`: the qa_group_gate recipe as written is refused 422 `security-owd-unset` (no sharingModel); provisioned with `sharingModel: 'public_read_write'` added.
- `records-forms.calendar-interactions`: the week/day time-grid move and the resize-end variants cannot be exercised on the stock fixture (date-only start field, no end field).
- `dashboards.global-filters-rescope` D2: the field-override combo offers only the dataset's declared dimensions, so the dateRange re-target needs a dataset with two date dimensions; region → status was re-targeted instead.
- `records-forms.action-location-matrix` A2: `open_docs` targets https://objectstack.ai, which this container's proxy refuses; the url leg is scored on the issued navigation.
- The checklist-accuracy findings (about 45 lines) go to the anchor #27377 in the final report, not here.

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 67 minutes in total across 11 runners, on the same boots and as the same personas (admin, demo personas, minted members; a walled group boot for one approvals probe).

Doors probed: approvals decision, action-route, reassign, recall, remind and comment doors; automation runs, trigger, resume, clone and toggle; the actions dispatcher; metadata save, draft read, history, audit, diff, rollback and publish-drafts; analytics dataset query; share-links and export; the named form page; dashboard and report save; flow publish and registration; book tree and doc read; the avatar menu.

Boundary classes tried: empty string, blank id, missing id, unknown id, wrong type, inverted or non-numeric versions, `limit=0`, partial nested objects, duplicate names, undeclared cycles, opposite posture (member on admin doors, draft vs active, walled vs single), and readers outside the asserted scope.

Findings that pass the filing gate are extracted as cards and listed in the close-out comment. One more:

- approvals.per-group-signoff · observed beside the clauses · security finding — detail withheld, reported to PM

Observations not filed, judged below the filing gate or by design:
- `POST /api/v1/actions/sys_approval_request/approval_approve` with recordId missing → 404 ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND rather than 400.
- `POST …/requests/areq_unknown/approve` → 404 whose error text is the bare id, while the GET says "Approval request 'areq_unknown' not found".
- every POST/PUT/DELETE on /automation logs "[Registry] Overwriting flow" once per org-scope flow.
- `GET …/history?limit=0` → 200 empty; `/diff?from=abc` → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED while `/rollback {"toVersion":"abc"}` → 400 INVALID_REQUEST; `/history` and `/audit` on an unknown name → 200 empty while `/diff` → 404.
- the ITEM_LOCKED remedy sentence still names the clone route while NOT_OVERRIDABLE names the pair; both are true remedies.
- RLS "Add tab" autosaves an empty-key row `tabPermissions: {"": "visible"}`, which save and publish accept.
- `/_console/studio/PKG/access?surface=permission:does_not_exist` opens the first set with no notice.
- duplicate widget ids on a dashboard are accepted; the runtime draws both tiles correctly.
- a form view for a nonexistent object saves and publishes 200 and renders nowhere.
- a summary rolling up a nonexistent child object saves valid and stays null (dangling references are tolerated as for lookups).
- an app whose navigation holds only doc entries opens on a blank main region.
- `field.referenceVia` in the header highlight strip shows the raw id text; the details-grid placement renders the card.
- a Studio RLS CHECK on a select policy reads "Valid CEL" beside a 422 that names it: this is #28664, fixed by PR #28884, which merged at 03:29Z, after this subject.
